name: High 5 Christmas Dig
description:
mix of stubble fields, pasture fields and newly cropped fields on this farm that have given up many finds that include 2 bronze age spears, multiple roman fibulas, roman coins, hammered coins, silver milled coins.
£5 to attend and for that price you'll get a free dinner and alcohol free hot mulled wine.
oken Hunting field open where you can win cash prizes if you find them tokens.
The cost for this is an additional £5 per detectorist for admission to the token hunt field.
Under 14's free of charge
